acceptable_incompleteness.why: The pinned snapshot is family_only and its completeness is not certified, so these rows are a source gap rather than a negative match. Row ids are not in the repository.

axes.note: Match-status buckets and the historical 6/994 review cut are different axes of the same 1000-input audit. The review cut is not reused as the new admission partition.

diagnostic_observations_not_acceptance_k.counterfactual_source: Epic #13308 / RF-002: dropping auxiliary UniProt xrefs was counted as 633 matched. That count is not an accuracy KPI.
diagnostic_observations_not_acceptance_k.intersection_source: Issue #13316 names 374 intersection matches. The row table is not in the repository, so this receipt does not recompute or accept that figure.

historical_review_not_reused.why: The previous 6 reviewed cases follow the old anchor policy. They do not admit the separated primary/auxiliary semantics.

unreviewed.why: Matched and ambiguous audit rows have no independent row-level review in this repository. Unreviewed rows are not labeled verified.

unsupported.why: Taxa outside 9606, 10090 and 10116 are outside the contract.

verified_expectations.why: No control-row identity is pinned here, and the historical 6 cases are not a verified set for the new semantics.
